requirements.body: While the boot is marked first-boot, the system shall present the setup wizard at `https://cubeos.cube` and not start the full service stack.
When the operator completes the wizard, the system shall write `/cubeos/data/.setup_complete` atomically and then start the full coreapp stack.
The system shall complete the boot sequence within 90 seconds on Raspberry Pi 5.
If the boot budget is exceeded, then the system shall log the slow-boot event with per-step timings to `/cubeos/data/boot.log`.
While boot is incomplete, the dashboard shall display a boot-progress UI driven by `GET /api/v1/system/boot`.
If the SQLite database is corrupted on boot, then the system shall attempt restoration from `/cubeos/data/backups/cubeos.db.last-known-good` and log the restoration event.
